spans.s: मेद् मेद् = rt. 1. मिद्, q. v.

मेद मेद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. मिद्), fat (=
मेदस् below); a species of plant (= अलम्बुषा);
a particular mixed caste (the son of a Vaideha by a
Kārāvara female); N. of a serpent-demon; (आ), f.
a root resembling ginger (said to be one of the
eight principal medicines, used especially in cases of
fever and consumption); (ई), f., see Gaṇa Gaurādi
to Pāṇ.

.
—मेद-ज, अस्, m. a species of
bdellium (= भूमिज-गुग्गुलु).
—मेद-पाट, N.
of a place.
—मेद-पाठ, अस्, m., N. of a branch
of the Vatsa family.
—मेद-भिल्ल, अस्, m., N. of a
degraded tribe.
—मेद-शिरस्, आस्, m., N. of a king.
—मेदोद्भवा (˚द-उद्˚), f. = मेदा above.

मेदक, अस्, m. spirituous liquor used for dis-
tillation.
मेदन, अम्, n., Ved. the act of fattening.

मेदस्, अस्, n. fat, marrow, lymph (as one of the
seven Dhātus or constituent elements of the body,
and supposed to be a serous or adipose secretion that
spreads amongst the muscular or fleshy fibres, per-
forming the same functions to the flesh that the
marrow of the bones performs to them; in Hindū
physiology its proper seat is said to be the abdomen);
vigour, energy (Ved.); corpulence; excessive fatness,
morbid or unnatural corpulence (= मेद-दोष); a
mystical term for the letter व्; [cf. perhaps Gr. μῡε-
λό-ς for μεδυλό-ς; Lat. medulla for medusla or
medurla.]
—मेदः-पुच्छ or मेदः-पुच्छक,
अस्, m. the fat-tailed sheep.
—मेदः-सार, अस्, आ,
अम्, one in whom the Dhātu fat predominates; (आ),
f. = मेदा.
—मेदस्-कृत्, त्, n. ‘fat-producing,’ the
body, flesh.
—मेदस्-तेजस्, अस्, n. ‘strength of the
Medas,’ bone.
—मेदस्-पिण्ड, अस्, m. a lump of
fat.
—मेदस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessed of fat,
fat.
—मेदस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, ‘having Medas,’ corpu-
lent, fat; robust, stout, strong.
—मेदो-गण्ड, अस्, m.,
Ved. a kind of fatty excrescence.
—मेदो-ग्रन्थि, इस्,
m. a lump or knot of fat, a fatty tumor.
—मेदो-ज,
अम्, n. ‘produced by Medas,’ bone.
—मेदो-धरा,
f. a membrane in the abdomen containing the fat,
the omentum.
—मेदो-ऽर्बुद, अम्, n. a fatty tumor
unattended with pain.
—मेदो-वती, f. = मेदा.
—मेदो-वह, अम्, n. (in anatomy) a vessel con-
veying fat, a lymphatic.
—मेदो-वृद्धि, इस्, f.
increase of fat, corpulence; enlargement of the
scrotum.

मेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. associated with another as
a friend or companion [cf. मित्र]; a partner, con-
federate, ally; (Sāy.) having Medas, possessing
vigour or energy, = मेदसा युक्त = बलवत्; (इनी),
f. the earth, land, soil, ground, landed property;
spot, place [cf. युद्ध-म्˚]; Gmelina Arborea; =
मेदा, q. v.; N. of a lexicon; (sometimes in comps.
spelt मेदिनि.)

मेदुर, अस्, आ, अम्, fat; smooth, soft, bland, unc-
tuous; thick, dense; (with inst. or at the end of a
comp.) thick with, as thick as, full of, covered with.
मेदुर मेदुर. See above.

मेदुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, thick, thickened, made
